units.source_text: 藤侍从看见薰君欣赏藤花时的神情，十分同情他的失恋之苦，便向他隐约表示此次大姐入院是他所不赞成的，也赋诗云：

en.t: When the Fuji Chamberlain saw Kaoru's expression as he admired the wisteria blossoms, he felt deep sympathy for the pain of his disappointed love, and so he hinted to him that he had not approved of the elder sister entering the palace on this occasion; he also composed a poem:
